public_rationale: LeCun offers reasons and analogies, so this is not simply an absence of reasoning. He also asserts the crucial design step without demonstrating enduring controllability. Marcus’s context challenges that step, rather than denying that any premises exist. Calling the argument unreal or circular therefore depends on an evaluative standard the claim does not specify. A binary factual verdict would overstate what the record settles.
limitations: This does not endorse LeCun’s conclusion or establish that his argument is sound.
The record permits analysis of the inference, but not an interpretation-independent grade of its adequacy.
